_notes: Bins/objects estimated from the overview/wrist camera photos (2026-11-21); replace with tape-measured values.

Calibrated 2026-11-21 (D:/Robotics-Hackathon/scripts/realsim): table extent + texture from a phone-video SfM orthomosaic scaled by the 100 mm ArUco markers; overview_cam pose/fovy from marker reprojection (0.6 px); lighting fitted to the real overview camera. Arm base located from the SfM points (+-1 cm until tape-checked).
Units: metres and degrees. Origin: centre of the arm base footprint on the table top (z = 0).
+y: direction the arm points at zero pose, towards the overview camera. Seen from that camera, image-left is +x.
Object pos is [x, y, z] of the body centre at rest; yaw rotates about z. Masses in kg.
table/bin sizes are full lengths; object 'parts' and 'fixed' sizes are MuJoCo half-sizes (cylinder: [radius, half-height]).

Cap puzzle task (assets/meshes/cap_puzzle): fixture box with the bottom part fixed on it, the inner part in its bore (hollow skirt up), and the cap ring screwed on the thread. Unscrew the cap (internal grip in its Ø61 lip, turn counter-clockwise seen from above), then pull the inner part out by spreading the jaws inside its Ø35 skirt.
pad_half_size: narrow 8 x 12 mm fingertips so the closed jaws (≈27 mm wide) fit inside the inner part's skirt.
